S1.do: Have a look, then tap the button on this card.
S1.why: I'm Ludwig, and you're coming to a gig with me. This is your Line, your concert-going life: down is the past, up is what's coming.

lineEmpty.do: Have a look, then tap the button on this card.
lineEmpty.why: I'm Ludwig, and you're coming to a gig with me. Your Line is empty for now: down is the past, up is what's coming.

S2.do: Open the planner at the top of your Line to add a gig.
S2.ios: Tap the plus in Future to add a gig.
S2.android: Pull down on your Line to add a gig.
S2.why: Anything you plan appears above today on your Line. This gig is a demo and is deleted when we finish.

lineEmpty.do: Tap “add a gig by hand” to plan our night.

S3.do: Type a band you actually like, then tap the right match in the list.
S3.why: The app asks MusicBrainz, a free public music database, to find the exact band, so we don't end up with the wrong one.

S4.do: Respectable taste. Not mine, but respectable. Enter a venue and a future date as dd-MM-yyyy, then tap Add.
S4.why: A date that hasn't happened yet makes it a planned gig, which waits on your Line until the night arrives.

S5.do: Tap the gig you just added.
S5.why: Every gig has a Room: its Log, photos, ticket and check-in all live there.

S6.do: Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back to your Line.
S6.why: Going left means going back, on every screen of the app. Worth remembering, because I won't be holding your hand.

line.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: Swipe right from the left edge of the screen to go back to your Line.

S7.do: Open the Exchange to meet me.
S7.why: An Exchange turns two people standing together into contacts. I'm pretend, so nothing leaves your phone. Your location, if you allow it, becomes the gig's venue.

exchange.do: Tap my name to exchange with me.

room.do: Swipe right from the left edge to return to your Line.

S8.do: Pinch two fingers together on your Line to zoom out.
S8.why: Zooming out puts my Line beside yours, and every friend you add gets their own. Mine has more gigs on it. You can see that for yourself.

room.do: Swipe right from the left edge to return to your Line.

S10.why: Your phone will ask for calendar access. The event is part of the demo and is deleted when we finish.
S10.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: Add this gig to your calendar.
room.ios: Scroll to the bottom and tap Add to calendar.
room.android: Swipe left in the Room, or tap “swipe to add to calendar”.

S11.why: This leaves the app for Maps. Come back when you've looked, and the Tour will still be here.
S11.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: In the Room, open directions to the venue in Maps.
room.ios: In the Room, tap Open in Maps to get directions.
room.android: In the Room, tap Open venue in Maps.

S12.why: That's the PDF ticket I sent you. The app read it and attached it to the gig; any ticket you share to the app lands the same way.
S12.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: Open your ticket in the Room, as you would at the door.
room.ios: Tap the white barcode in the Room, as you would at the door.

S13.why: A check-in says you were at this gig. While you're checked in, nearby phones may carry what you log to others. Nothing is sent during the Tour.
S13.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: Tap “I'm here — check in”, then confirm if asked.

S14.why: The Log is your own setlist, kept as the night happens. Nobody is marking it, so any song you know will do.
S14.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: They’re playing “{opener}” as the opener. Type it into the Log, then add it.
room.fallback: Type the first song they played into the Log, then add it.

S15.why: A Gap is an honest blank: they played something and you couldn't name it. It beats a Log that pretends to be complete.
S15.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: In the Log, tap “they played one I can't name”.

S16.why: Gossip is how phones in radio range swap what happened at a gig, friends or strangers, with no server. Mine just filled your Gap.
S16.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: Read song two in your Log: that's gossip from my phone. Then carry on.

S17.why: setlist.fm has the rest of tonight’s set. Watch it arrive in your Log. Even I can’t remember everything.
S17.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: Tick “That was the whole set” in the Room.

S18.why: Shared photos can go to friends you've exchanged with. Private ones stay on your phone. Your photo stays in your library either way.
S18.do: Tap our gig to open its Room.

room.do: Tap the camera on this card and take a selfie.

roomAfterPhoto.do: Add your selfie from the photo library.
roomAfterPhoto.ios: Tap Add to shared or Add to the vault, then choose your selfie.
roomAfterPhoto.android: Drag the ↕ handle up for shared or down for private, then choose your selfie.

S19.do: Swipe the gig left to turn tonight’s set into a Spotify playlist.
S19.why: You'll log in to Spotify. The public playlist is the one thing this Tour keeps; everything else, including the demo gig, is deleted.

room.do: Swipe right from the left edge to return to your Line.

notes.setlistFill: The rest comes from setlist.fm, where fans log what bands play.

playlist.title: Went to a gig with Ludwig
playlist.description: Achievement unlocked: survived a whole gig with Ludwig. He arrived early, left late and had opinions about the support act throughout.
